北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓，体感很冷，注意保暖和交通安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and feels very cold. Stay warm and drive safe!

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴冷湿度大，体感接近冰点，多穿衣物别感冒。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and humid. It feels near freezing, so dress warmly to avoid colds.

南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾且湿度大，体感寒冷，出行请慢行。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is very foggy and humid, feeling cold. Drive carefully.

重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is partly cloudy at 6℃ with high humidity. It feels a bit cool, add a layer.

昆明.name: 昆明
